[[File:LittlePetrovi-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The battle of Little Petrovi]]
In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], a '''battle''' was fought at the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] celestial body [[Little Petrovi/Legends|Little Petrovi]] as part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Reconquest of the Rim]]. It was one of the several engagements of the operation for which the [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] gained fame.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
